issues.description: The template implementation of GroverMultiQubitMultiSolutionsWithAuxiliaryQubit.oracle has the parameter `combinations` typed as a single str, but the problem statement and the solution expect `combinations` to be a list of bit-strings (list[str]). This mismatch appears inside the same exercise (template oracle) and between template and solution, which will confuse students implementing the overriding oracle: they will expect to receive a list but the template signature suggests a single string.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template oracle signature to accept a list of bit-strings (combinations: list[str]) to match the problem statement and solution. Also update the docstring to explicitly state the parameter type is list[str]. Example: def oracle(..., combinations: list[str]) -> QuantumCircuit: and ensure the grover_circuit call-sites and docstrings use the same type.
